verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents its own policy workflow: an optional strict publishing flow that needs a separate Approver's sign-off, plus marketing claims that users can create, review, and acknowledge published policies. Templates appear only as specific HIPAA artifacts (breach notification and disclosure log), not as a lawyer-grade policy library. missing for 10: a documented lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-product policy editor, policy versioning, explicit per-employee acceptance tracking and reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking

citations.quote: The new workflow requires a separate Approver's sign-off before any policy is published.
Accelerate the ability to create, review, and acknowledge published policies with direct automation.
Create policies in minutes and prep for your audit in no time.
A breach notification template is available to meet HIPAA reporting standards, including placeholders for incident-specific details.
